programs.title: Biweekly competitions

programs.body: Beginner-friendly sessions for breaking down systems, testing tools, and learning the why behind the tech.

programs.title: AWS technical writing
programs.body: Practice the skill that makes technical work useful: explaining systems, decisions, and results so someone else can build on them.

programs.title: Career labs
programs.body: Job interview practice, leadership roles, and industry conversations that make the path from classroom to career feel less mysterious.

events.description: Competitions, workshops, leadership roles, interview practice, and a Discord full of people learning in public.

events.title: AI & Data Competition

events.title: Enterprise Computing with IBM
events.description: A career talk about enterprise systems, cloud, cybersecurity, data centers, and how big companies actually run.

events.title: Reverse Engineering
events.description: Work backwards, think forwards, and uncover how programs really work. Beginner-friendly by design.

events.title: Internship Apocalypse
events.description: A chaotic, useful reaction to terrible job postings, weird recruiter behavior, rejection stories, and better strategy.
